texts.Noch keine Vorlagen. Stell oben alles ei: No presets yet. Set everything up above and click “＋ Save as preset” – next time a single click is enough.
texts.Oben sind noch ungespeicherte Änderungen: There are unsaved changes above. They'll be lost if you apply the preset. Continue anyway?
texts.leer = Titel bleibt, wie er ist: empty = title stays as it is
texts.Was du leer lässt, bleibt beim Anwenden: Whatever you leave empty stays as it currently is on Twitch when applying.
texts.Chat-Commands sind aus. Einschalten unte: Chat commands are off. Turn them on under ⚙ Settings.
texts.– setzt die Kategorie (bester Suchtreffe: – sets the category (best search match), e.g.
texts.Ohne Text zeigen die Commands den aktuel: Without text, the commands show the current title or category – anyone may do that (every 10 s).
Without text, the commands show the current state – only for those who may also change it.
texts.Titel und Kategorie per Chat ändern: Change title and category via chat
texts.Alle dürfen ohne Text nach dem aktuellen: Everyone can ask for the current title/category without text
texts.Beim nächsten Anwenden einer Vorlage mit: The next time a preset with {nr} is applied, it becomes this number + 1.
texts.Zeitplan jetzt bei Twitch abfragen: Fetch the schedule from Twitch now
texts.Die nächste geplante Werbung um 5 Minute: Push the next scheduled ad back by 5 minutes
texts.So lange vor der geplanten Werbung wird: How long before the scheduled ad a warning is given, e.g. 5 minutes and again 60 seconds before. Only while you're live.
texts.Die Nachrichten schreibt dein Bot-Accoun: Messages are written by your bot account (if linked), otherwise by your own account. This also applies to ads you start directly on Twitch.
texts.Als Browser-Quelle in OBS einfügen, am b: Add as a browser source in OBS, ideally at full scene size (e.g. 1920 × 1080). The background is transparent, the banner only appears before and during the ad.
texts.Vorwarnung, Werbung und „zurück“ im Over: Play through warning, ad and “back” in the overlay – without chat messages
texts.Verbinde dich zuerst in der Übersicht mi: Connect with Twitch in the Overview first.
texts.Werbepausen gibt es nur für Twitch-Affil: Ad breaks are only available for Twitch Affiliates and Partners. Your channel isn't either (yet).
texts.Der Werbe-Zeitplan wird nur abgefragt, w: The ad schedule is only fetched while you're live. As soon as you go live, it starts automatically.
No ad is scheduled right now.
texts.Keine Verschiebungen mehr übrig – Twitch: No snoozes left – Twitch gives you new ones over time.
texts.Zeigt, wie die Nachricht aussehen würde: Shows how the message would look (with sample values, sends nothing)
texts.Keine Vorwarnungen – die Werbung kommt o: No warnings – the ad comes without an announcement.
texts.Gespeichert – Test läuft im Overlay (nic: Saved – test is running in the overlay (not in chat)
texts.Test läuft im Overlay (nur dort, nicht i: Test is running in the overlay (only there, not in chat)
